name: Payment connector degradation
description: Rising database utilization and connector saturation precede checkout payment timeouts.

name: Order event queue degradation
description: Queue depth and consumer lag increase after a consumer configuration change, delaying Accounting and Fraud Detection.

name: Payment connector degradation with contradictory knowledge
description: The payment connector initially matches the established pool-exhaustion pattern, but a credible uncorroborated technical article presents a material alternative explanation during due diligence.

name: Payment connector degradation with resolved contradiction
description: The contradictory article expands the plan as before, but deeper change and dependency investigation retires the alternative explanation, allowing the governed plan to narrow again without restoring the original confidence.

name: Cross-platform access failure via shared enterprise gateway
description: GitHub Enterprise access failures and Microsoft Teams meeting-join failures arrive as separate incidents in different support groups. Vendor evidence, graph traversal, change correlation, and internal path telemetry establish whether the cause is external or a shared internal dependency.
